extracted.name: Chicken and Waffles with Honey Butter
extracted.description: Originated in nyc.. a lady in harlem was the first to put this meal/brunch together... QUICK AND EASY!!! enjoy🗽✌️
ingredient_lines: 2 pieces (about 200g each) Chicken breast or thighs
instruction_lines: Mix pancake mix with water or milk and cook waffles according to package instructions.
Coat chicken with mustard and hot sauce, then season with salt and pepper.
Dredge chicken in flour, then coat with bread crumbs.
Heat oil in a pan and fry chicken until golden and cooked through.
Mix butter and honey to make honey butter.
Serve waffles topped with fried chicken, honey butter, and a sprinkle of powdered sugar.
